text: Ɓe gomɗinaa ɓen Darngal, hino ɗaɓɓa yaccingol fii maggal; tawde ɓe gomɗinaa fii hasboore wanaa warjeede wanaa fii lepte. Gomɗimɓe Allah ɓen kan, ko ɓe hulu ɓe fii maggal, e hoore hiɓe felliti wonnde ko ngal goonga, mo sikke alaa e mu'un. Awa anndee wonɓe yeddondireede ɓen e fii Darngal, hara hiɓe sikkitii daragol maggal, ko pellet, ɓe wonii e nder majjere woɗɗunde goonga.
